derived_from.effects_section_6: The thirteen rows of the table of reference steps. A row naming two cases is two transitions here (perform and resume dispatch; resume in and not in tail position). AbandonFrame, which the table gives once, is one transition per kind of frame the step record can tell apart.

tc0_a_catalog.use: Its frames, controls, dispatch, collect, root and site rules apply unchanged to TC1 programs. Steps at TC0-A forms and frames (let, if, match, prim, tuple, project, construct, emit, call, apply, the root machine) that are not AbandonFrame steps are TC0-A transitions: they are not keys of this catalog and are measured by the TC0-A coverage row.

controls_added.meaning: A segment is being discarded after discontinue; one frame per step, no user code runs

frames_added.return: Value: pop; the value passes through unchanged (HandleReturn). Unwind or Abandon: discard one frame
Value: replaced by its segment; the value is the result of the perform (ClauseReturn). Unwind or Abandon: replaced by its segment, which is discarded next
Value: pop; the clause value is the value of the handle (ClauseExitReturn)
Value: pop; the handled body value is the value of the resume (ResumeReturn)
Abandon reaching it: pop and produce unit (DiscontinueReturn)

depth: Depth is the number of active frames after the step; a segment held by a clause frame counts as that one frame, one held in a resumption as none. A transition's depth field is the change from the previous step's depth (0 before the first step): "+1", "0", "-1", or a bound such as "<=0", ">=0", ">=+1", ">=+2" where it depends on the segment size s >= 1.
classification: A step is keyed by its site rule, the form of the program node at its site, and its after control. Forms are read from the decoded program: handle, perform, resume, discontinue, let, if, match, a strict form (prim, tuple, project, construct, emit) and call or apply.
Ready at a perform node: the clause form is that of the clause whose body root the next step dispatches.

Ready at a resume node: in tail position when the resume is reached through tail positions only from its clause body root: a clause, handle or function body, a let body, an if branch or a match arm in such a position.
AbandonFrame or UnwindFrame at a perform node: a clause frame when the depth does not fall (it gives back at least the handler frame), otherwise a collect or clause-exit frame.
A step at a handler form, or an AbandonFrame step, whose key is not listed here is outside the catalog; so is a step whose depth change contradicts its transition.

transitions.key: Dispatch handle -> Eval
transitions.frames: handler frame pushed; the body is entered in tail position
transitions.source: EFFECTS.md section 6, row "Dispatch handle"

transitions.key: Dispatch perform -> Eval
transitions.frames: collect frame pushed for the one argument
transitions.source: EFFECTS.md section 6, row "Dispatch perform, resume"

transitions.key: Dispatch resume -> Eval
transitions.frames: collect frame pushed for the one argument
transitions.source: EFFECTS.md section 6, row "Dispatch perform, resume"

transitions.key: Dispatch discontinue -> Ready
transitions.frames: none: discontinue has no operand and is Ready at once
transitions.source: Not tabulated in section 6; EFFECTS.md section 2 (discontinue(k) has no argument) with the TC0-A catalog dispatch rule for a strict form without operands ("a nullary construct enters Ready directly")

transitions.key: CollectReturn perform -> Ready
transitions.frames: collect frame popped; the argument is stored
transitions.source: Not tabulated in section 6; the TC0-A catalog Collect frame return rule applied to the one argument of perform (EFFECTS.md section 2: strict in its one argument, like a call)

transitions.key: CollectReturn resume -> Ready
transitions.frames: collect frame popped; the argument is stored
transitions.source: Not tabulated in section 6; the TC0-A catalog Collect frame return rule applied to the one argument of resume

transitions.key: Ready perform, clause op(x) -> Eval
transitions.frames: the suspended segment (perform site out to and including the selected handler, s >= 1 frames) replaced by one clause frame; the clause body is entered
transitions.source: EFFECTS.md section 6, row "Ready perform, clause op(x)"

transitions.key: Ready perform, clause op(x,k) -> Eval
transitions.frames: the segment (s >= 1 frames) removed into k; one clause-exit frame pushed; the clause body is entered
transitions.source: EFFECTS.md section 6, row "Ready perform, clause op(x,k)"

transitions.key: Ready resume, not in tail position -> Value
transitions.frames: resume-return frame pushed, then the segment (s >= 1 frames); the value is delivered at the perform site
transitions.source: EFFECTS.md section 6, row "Ready resume", not in tail position

transitions.key: Ready resume, in tail position -> Value
transitions.frames: the segment (s >= 1 frames) pushed, no frame of its own; the value is delivered at the perform site
transitions.source: EFFECTS.md section 6, row "Ready resume", in tail position (section 7: a resume in tail position pushes no frame)

transitions.key: Ready discontinue -> Abandon
transitions.frames: discontinue-return frame pushed, then the segment (s >= 1 frames)
transitions.source: EFFECTS.md section 6, row "Ready discontinue"

transitions.key: HandleReturn -> Value
transitions.frames: handler frame popped; the body value is the value of the handle
transitions.source: EFFECTS.md section 6, row "HandleReturn"

transitions.key: ClauseReturn -> Value
transitions.frames: clause frame replaced by the segment it holds (s >= 1 frames); the clause value is the result of the perform
transitions.source: EFFECTS.md section 6, row "ClauseReturn"

transitions.key: ClauseExitReturn -> Value
transitions.frames: clause-exit frame popped; the clause value is the value of the handle
transitions.source: EFFECTS.md section 6, row "ClauseExitReturn"

transitions.key: ResumeReturn -> Value
transitions.frames: resume-return frame popped; the handled body value is the value of the resume
transitions.source: EFFECTS.md section 6, row "ResumeReturn"

transitions.key: DiscontinueReturn -> Value
transitions.frames: discontinue-return frame popped; the value is unit
transitions.source: EFFECTS.md section 6, row "DiscontinueReturn"

transitions.key: AbandonFrame at a let frame -> Abandon
transitions.frames: one let frame discarded
transitions.source: EFFECTS.md section 6, row "AbandonFrame", at a TC0-A let frame

transitions.key: AbandonFrame at an if frame -> Abandon
transitions.frames: one if frame discarded
transitions.source: EFFECTS.md section 6, row "AbandonFrame", at a TC0-A if frame

transitions.key: AbandonFrame at a match frame -> Abandon
transitions.frames: one match frame discarded
transitions.source: EFFECTS.md section 6, row "AbandonFrame", at a TC0-A match frame

transitions.key: AbandonFrame at an operand collection of a strict form -> Abandon
transitions.site: prim, tuple, project, construct or emit node / AbandonFrame
transitions.frames: one collect frame discarded

transitions.source: EFFECTS.md section 6, row "AbandonFrame", at a handler frame

transitions.key: AbandonFrame at a clause frame -> Abandon
transitions.frames: a clause frame replaced by the segment it holds (s >= 1), which is abandoned next
transitions.source: EFFECTS.md section 6, row "AbandonFrame", at a clause frame; by analogy with "UnwindFrame at a clause frame" (section 6 does not say that abandoning a clause frame exposes its segment)

transitions.key: UnwindFrame at a handler frame -> Unwind
transitions.frames: one handler frame discarded
transitions.source: Not tabulated in section 6; section 4 (a trap in the body unwinds through the handler) with the TC0-A catalog root rule "Unwind discards one frame per step"

transitions.key: UnwindFrame at a clause frame -> Unwind
transitions.frames: clause frame replaced by the segment it holds (s >= 1), which unwinds next
transitions.source: EFFECTS.md section 6, row "UnwindFrame at a clause frame"

transitions.key: UnwindFrame at a perform node, collection or clause-exit frame -> Unwind
transitions.frames: one collect or clause-exit frame discarded (the step record does not say which)
transitions.source: Not tabulated in section 6; the TC0-A root rule "Unwind discards one frame per step" at a collect frame of perform, or at a clause-exit frame when an explicit clause traps (section 4, clause trap aborts)

transitions.key: UnwindFrame at a resume node, collection or resume-return frame -> Unwind
transitions.frames: one collect or resume-return frame discarded (the step record does not say which)
transitions.source: Not tabulated in section 6; the TC0-A root rule "Unwind discards one frame per step" at a collect frame of resume, or at a resume-return frame when the resumed body traps
